problems.site: A1-settle.md:52, 78, 157-171 (the epsilon that removes O-BITS; grade row H-SETTLE-W alone); settle.py:241-265 (eps_to_remove / eps_any_advantage); B-combine.md:331-335 (T-E table 'nlcontrol pairs, N = 7 (upper figure, one Hamiltonian)')
problems.wrong: eps > eps_any(L,N) and N >= 7 pairs per qubit ('7 if each qubit is coded alone', '7 per qubit') are presented as the condition under which O-BITS is removed. B labels the N = 7 totals an 'upper figure'. Both quantities are computed from N*C(D) >= 2. That is Shannon's converse, a necessary condition. It is not sufficient.
problems.correct: These are FLOORS. At D < 1 both of Alice's inputs produce both of Bob's outcomes with positive probability (Z-channel for nlcontrol, BSC for H2), so the zero-error capacity is 0. Per-qubit coding with any finite N therefore never delivers the 2 bits with certainty. Reliable transmission needs block coding over many qubits at a rate strictly below C, with error, and so teleportation infidelity, going to 0 only as the block length goes to infinity. The block-coding premise (call it H-BLOCK) should be named in the removal's support. '7 per qubit' should read '>= 7 (floor)'. 'Upper figure' is correct only relative to the W2 class; within nlcontrol, N = 7 is a lower bound. A1, A2, A3 and B also state the same removal's premise set differently (H-BORN-AT-BOB and H-NLCONTROL-FORM appear in some and not others); it should be one set.

problems.site: settle.py:50 and 361-391 (H-BORN-AT-BOB 'Born-rule measurement of his drifted qubit'; readout_holevo_check samples 2x2 only; W2_CLASS_CEILING = log2 2); A1-settle.md s.1b (ceiling bullet and pairs table); A2-frame.md Combinations; B-combine.md T-E 'W2 class floor' column; combine.py B-CAP ground
problems.wrong: The W2 class floor of more than 2 pairs per teleported qubit, and at least 3 per qubit at finite T, rests on a premise nobody named: that the drift acts on Bob's received qubit and nothing else. A per-branch deterministic drift that also acts on Bob's local apparatus, an ancilla in a fixed state independent of Alice, still has W2's form. Holevo at a Born readout of that drifted system is capped at log2(2d) bits per pair, not 1. The rank-2 argument fails there too. A flow is injective, but it can bring Alice's two outcome branches close together while moving different basis choices into near-orthogonal subspaces. Each choice's state is then near-pure, and chi tends to log2 k for k settings when 2d >= k. C-verify-1's four-basis D-CTC discriminator at 2 bits per pair is an instance of this.
problems.correct: Name the premise, for example H-QUBIT-DRIFT. Under H-BORN-AT-BOB + H-QUBIT-DRIFT the floor stands: > 2 on average, >= 3 per qubit at finite T. Under H-BORN-AT-BOB alone, the ceiling per pair is log2 of the drifted system's dimension (Holevo, READ in A3). The class's pairs per qubit is then OPEN, down to 1 with 4 settings and a 2-qubit ancilla. That is DERIVED, not computed: any tangent field v orthogonal to psi equals -iH(psi)psi with H = i(v psi^dag - psi v^dag), which is Hermitian, so any smooth isotopy of CP^3 is a W2 flow. Until a Hamiltonian is computed, B's 'W2 class floor' column and A1's table should be labelled as the qubit-only subclass. This is not evidence such a drift exists.

problems.site: A2-frame.md Grades table, clause 2b O-BITS ('LEAVES; a channel needs H-SETTLE under C2'); A2-frame.json clause-2b grade (O-BITS LEAVES) against the 'Deutsch D-CTC under C2 (a clause-2b world)' grade (REMOVED-IF); combine.py B-NOCOM (SIG => W2) and B-CAP (CAP == SIG and N_EPS)

That route needs no epsilon and no drift time, and it is not subject to the Weinberg spin bounds. Yet clause 2b's O-BITS column reads LEAVES. The screen sends every signal through W2 plus N_EPS, so at 1 AU, N = 7, every F2b variant without H12 is O-BITS LEFT, and the D-CTC route appears nowhere in combine. B names the clause-2b O-MAKE pathway as an uncarried encoding choice, but not this one.

Under M-S1A-P3 that loop is disqualifying at the seat only. In combine, either carry it as an F2b pathway whose support does not include N_EPS, which changes F2b's O-BITS at 1 AU, or name its absence as an encoding choice. A CTC is not shown to exist, and Hawking's conjecture stays OPEN.

problems.site: combine.py N_CORR / B-TIMEFUNC against N_QTOPO / B-TOPO / B-THROAT; B-combine.md s.3 best variant {W2, ITB}, and the premise-clash table. This direction is against M, outside this lens, recorded so that over-representation is avoided both ways.

These are two accounts of one corridor, the same shape the repair named as a premise clash for ITB+RQ (512 variants). {N_QTOPO, N_CORR} is never named, so '3 of 5' and 'removed-only 2' mix incompatible corridor models.

Applying the rule symmetrically: under ITB + N_QTOPO, the FRW lemma and latticectc's loop theorem do not bind the corridor, so O-LOOP for corridors is NOT-BOUND-IF {N_QTOPO}, not REMOVED-IF. Loops made by signals stay REMOVED-IF {N_FRW or a frame, N_SIGKEY}. The five-way removed-or-not-bound count can stay at 3, but O-LOOP's verdict changes, and in ITB variants the removed-only maximum falls from 2 to 1 for corridor loops.

Move H-MAP, H-TRANSFER and H-SPIN to the exclusion column.

Calling it 'in scope' presents a scope extension as within scope. This is the mirror of the repair's rule: a theorem carried outside its scope does not establish its conclusion against M either.

problems.site: combine.py B-RECV (encoded as a bare A['RECV'], no premise) and C-INFOS; B-combine.md clash (d); A3-measure.md H-INFO-S

S10 rests on C3 (renormalisable couplings, dimension <= 4; a higher-dimension operator carrying B or L would reverse it, per LEDGER), on P-UNIFORM and on H-UNSOURCED-SEAT. Bekenstein holds for 'complete, weakly self-gravitating, isolated objects' (p.2), with E the gravitating energy, a geometric quantity. phi(1) = 0 requires 2^I distinguishable states at the destination, not that they be matter already there.
problems.correct: Keep clash (d) labelled CLASH, board versus M (M's to rule). Encoding B-RECV with a premise would let INFOS remove O-MATTER by assertion, which is over-representation the other way. But list B-RECV's conditions beside the clash: C3 / P-UNIFORM / H-UNSOURCED-SEAT, Bekenstein's scope, and 'the holder's states are material'. Then M can see what a ruling would have to overturn. O-MATTER's survival is unchanged.
